title: Shinonome Ena — Frustration, Regret and Gratitude〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line:
Oh, thank you very much.
Please take your dishes over to soak.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Oh, also, Mom.
Is the bath ready?

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line:
It should be soon...
Would you like to go first, Ena?

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line:
Oh, I almost forgot!
I came up here to discuss food with you...

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: I heard about this wonderful place with delicious pasta and custard pudding from my friends!

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: How about we go have lunch there together?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (She did take me out for a really nice lunch today.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
No, it's okay. You go first.
I'll wash the dishes.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Huh?! Akito?! What happened?!
You didn't break your plate, did you?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It didn't break. I just dropped it in the water. If anything, it's your fault for saying something weird.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Excuse me? What exactly did I say that was so weird?

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line:
You two honestly never change.
Akito, I'll be taking my bath first if you don't mind.

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line:
Thank you.
Ena, I'll leave the dishes to you.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I feel that I should every now and then.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Wait, I know!
She promised to buy you something, huh?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What? No, I was just showing her some gratitude.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: No! She didn't promise to buy you something, because she already did!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Or... You two went out for good food.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Oh, he's right on the money. But I'm still not telling him...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
What was that grin?
I knew it. There's something going on.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You're free to believe whatever you want.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Anyway, I've done my share for Mom.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But there's something I need to tell you two...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I just saw Mafuyu and let her know that it's okay for her to run.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I agree that Mafuyu should keep that option in mind considering her current state.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah. As much as I want her to directly fight back, I guess she should have some contingencies ready if she doesn't think she can...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Mizuki was probably the right person to tell her that...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I wish there was something I could do to help.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Anyway, wanna head back?
I told you guys what I wanted to...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You met Mafuyu in person, right, Mizuki? How was she?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: She was in pretty rough shape at first...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: So, before we sat down to talk, I took her around to a few places and hung out with her a little...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, I almost forgot! We went to SpoJoy Park! She seemed to feel much better after we spent some time there!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Which is why I'm hoping that she's feeling a little better now...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I see... I'm glad to hear that...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Especially considering how our last conversation ended...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Okay, fine... Let's say you're right...
Even so, now's not the time for any of that...!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<You need to show her that you're mad...
Because if you don't, she's gonna smash you to pieces!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
I-It's not bothering me per se...
But I sort of just unloaded on her...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: That's why I want to apologize to her in person...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: To be fair, Mafuyu probably understands that you're worried about her.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Anyway, shall we get back to work?
We should be ready for Mafuyu to return whenever.
